class.name: GameplayTagTable
class.brief_description: Resource declaring gameplay tags: the authoring source of the tag hierarchy.
class.description: A tag name to description dictionary. List each table in the [code]application/game_framework/gameplay_tag_tables[/code] project setting; several tables are merged, so a project can split them per feature or ship one inside an addon. Only declared names are keys. Declaring [code]Ability.Combat.Melee[/code] also registers [code]Ability[/code] and [code]Ability.Combat[/code] as usable tags, but they carry no description of their own until some table declares them explicitly. Selecting a table in the FileSystem dock opens a tree editor for it: double-click a row to edit a name or a description, and renaming a tag rewrites its whole subtree as a single undo step.

method.name: get_description
method.description: The description this table gives [param tag_name], or an empty string.

method.name: get_tag_names
method.description: Every name this table declares, sorted - so merging several tables stays deterministic regardless of the order the dictionary happens to be stored in.

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Whether this table declares [param tag_name] outright. An ancestor it only implies does not count.

members.member: Tag name to description. Only declared names are keys: declaring [code]Ability.Combat.Melee[/code] also registers [code]Ability[/code] and [code]Ability.Combat[/code] as usable tags, but they carry no description until some table declares them outright. Stored as a typed dictionary so the .tres writes one tag per line, which keeps diffs and merges readable.
